note: Both sets capture the notes correctly for the sub-panel, inverters, the two NFDS and the junction box, and both share the same errors: ground fault protection misbound to the Main Breaker with a fabricated quote, an invented 4→31 connection between callout numbers, and 3W/phase attributed to a generic "PV Equipment" instead of the SUB-PANEL PV. Set A adds two clearly misread claims treating the diagram callouts 20 and 4 as terminal values of a "PV Equipment Circuit 1", plus two trivial label claims and a loose "compliance: NEC 690.42 EXCEPTION" claim that drops the conductor-to-ground bond condition. Set B keeps that NEC 690.42 EXCEPTION as a condition on the inverter ground-fault claim with a supporting quote, and its only extra errors are one callout read as a wire size and one invented 20→34 connection. On balance B has fewer wrong claims and the better-grounded inverter/NEC claim.
remarks: The numbers 20, 31, 34, 4, 5 in the diagram are note/detail callouts on symbols, not wire sizes, terminal values or component identifiers; both extractors misread them. Both sets also lose the distinct fact of note 4 that the required conductor-to-ground bond is made by the ground fault protection device under the NEC 690.42 exception. The text layer garbles the phase symbol (1□) and truncates quotes; the quote 'MAIN BREAKER TER WITH GROUND FAULT' in both sets appears to be a splice of 'MAIN BREAKER' and 'INVERTER WITH GROUND FAULT' and is not on the page.
